definitions.explanation: A person or entity that produces goods, especially agricultural products or manufactured items.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{生産者|せいさんしゃ}を{応援|おうえん}する。
{生産者|せいさんしゃ}の{顔|かお}が{見|み}える{野菜|やさい}を{選|えら}ぶ。
examples.english: To choose vegetables where you can see the producer's face.

examples.japanese: この{道|みち}の{駅|えき}では{生産者|せいさんしゃ}が{直接|ちょくせつ}{野菜|やさい}や{果物|くだもの}を{販売|はんばい}している。
examples.english: At this roadside station, producers sell vegetables and fruits directly.

notes:
A compound of {生産|せいさん} (production) and {者|しゃ} (person). Commonly used for farmers, fishermen, and other primary producers, but also applicable to manufacturers. In the food industry, {生産者|せいさんしゃ}の{顔|かお}が{見|み}える (being able to see the producer's face) has become a marketing concept emphasizing traceability and trust.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生産者|せいさんしゃ}{直売|ちょくばい}: direct sales from the producer
- {生産者|せいさんしゃ}{価格|かかく}: producer price
- {生産者|せいさんしゃ}{情報|じょうほう}: producer information
- {地元|じもと}の{生産者|せいさんしゃ}: local producers
- {生産者|せいさんしゃ}{団体|だんたい}: producers' association

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {消費者|しょうひしゃ}: consumer — the counterpart, one who uses/buys the product
- {製造者|せいぞうしゃ}: manufacturer — specifically for factory-made goods
- {農家|のうか}: farmer — specifically a farming household
